'''Gibbs''' was a [[Duros]] individual who resided in [[the galaxy]]. At some point, they acknowledged that an issue was occurring.<ref name="Trailer Subtitles" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gibbs appeared in "[[One Good Deed]]," the sixth episode of the [[2025]] [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'', which premiered on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-underworld-announce|text=Two Favorite ''Star Wars'' Bounty Hunters are Back for ''Tales of the Underworld''}}</ref> Gibbs was voiced by [[Michael Bell]].<ref name="One Good Deed" />
